_about: REF-011 World->Gameplay anchor contract for the sales floor; ART-007 builds the anchors from it. Gameplay finds anchors by NAME (GameObject.Find), never by position or order in this file. pos_ft = [x, y] in the ROOM_FIXTURES / REFERENCES_INDEX 1.2 frame (feet, origin Retail NW outer corner, +x east, +y south; Unity X = x*0.3048, Z = -y*0.3048). facing = compass direction the person at the anchor looks; yaw_deg 0 = plan north, 90 = east (graybox convention). aliases = older names already used in code (SLICE_DESIGN 7, GAME-008, GrayboxBuilder): ART-007 creates each alias as an extra empty at the same pose so existing lookups keep working until Gameplay migrates. Anchor_QueueSlot_0..3 = Anchor_Queue_0..3; Anchor_CheckInDesk = Anchor_CheckIn; Anchor_ServiceCustomer / Anchor_ServicePlayer = the player station's _Call / _Operator (station 08 today, GAP-134). Positions that are guesses are Low with a GAP id (GAP-129..134, Docs/KNOWN_GAPS.md).

player_station.note: graybox stations.slice = 08 (north run) holds Interact_Terminal / Interact_Scale today; the real station the player should use is a question for Nolan
